tool.archive_now.description: Commit the changes in a directory and push them to its git remote. No empty commits when nothing changed; failed pushes return an actionable fix and never force-push.
tool.archive_now.param.repo: Directory to archive (absolute, or relative to the current session working directory). Defaults to the session working directory.
tool.archive_now.param.message: Optional commit message template supporting {date} and {count} placeholders. Omit to use the default format.
tool.archive_now.param.push: Whether to push to the remote. false commits locally only. Defaults to the plugin config.
tool.archive_now.param.dry_run: When true, only report which files would be committed and how many commits are unpushed. Touches nothing.
tool.archive_status.description: Read-only report: current branch, pending file count, unpushed commit count, remote presence, whether a commit identity is configured, and the last archive result.
tool.archive_status.param.repo: Directory to inspect (absolute, or relative to the current session working directory). Defaults to the session working directory.
render.pushedPending:
Previously pending commits pushed ✅
Repo: {repo} (branch {branch})
Unpushed: {unpushedBefore} → now in sync
Push: succeeded on attempt {attempts}{rebased}
render.upToDate:
Nothing to archive: working tree clean and in sync with remote ✓
Repo: {repo} (branch {branch})
render.nothingToPush:
Committed, but the remote is already up to date
Repo: {repo} (branch {branch})
render.rebased: , with an automatic rebase onto new remote commits
error.GIT_MISSING: git was not found. Install Git and make sure it is on PATH (Windows: https://git-scm.com/download/win , macOS: xcode-select --install , Linux: apt install git), then retry.
error.NOT_A_REPO: That directory is not a git repository: {detail}. Run git init there and add a remote (git remote add origin <url>) first.
error.REPO_REQUIRED: A directory is required: pass the repo parameter, or switch to a working directory first.
error.IDENTITY_MISSING: This repo has no commit identity configured, so nothing can be committed. Run git config user.name "Your Name" and git config user.email "you@example.com" (repo: {detail}).
error.AUTH_REQUIRED:
Remote authentication failed. Run git push once in your own terminal to authorize (system credential manager / SSH agent); this plugin reuses those credentials and never stores a token itself.
Detail: {detail}
error.NO_REMOTE: This repo has no remote configured. Run git remote add origin <url> first (repo: {detail}).
error.DIVERGED:
The remote has conflicting changes and the rebase failed. It was aborted and your local commits are intact (no force-push was attempted). Resolve the conflict manually, then archive again.
Detail: {detail}
error.PUSH_FAILED:
Push failed. Your local commit is preserved; archiving again after fixing network or permissions will push it automatically.
Detail: {detail}
error.COMMIT_FAILED:
Commit failed and the repo was left untouched.
Detail: {detail}
tool.archive_cleanup_report.description: Read-only report listing files created this turn that look like disposable cache. The mode is report-only: nothing on disk is changed.
tool.archive_cleanup_report.param.repo: Directory to inspect (defaults to the configured repo or the current working directory).
tool.archive_cleanup_report.param.dry_ru: Reserved; the implementation is always report-only.
render.nothingToCommit:
Nothing to archive this turn (no changes, or all of them are cache)
Repo: {repo}
error.OFFLINE:
Network or proxy unreachable, so nothing was pushed. The local commit is preserved; archiving again once the network is back pushes it automatically.
Detail: {detail}
tool.archive_root_policy.description: Read-only judgement: scan the files at the repo root and group them into keep-at-root, movable (with a suggested target directory), and needs-a-human. Moves and deletes nothing.
tool.archive_root_policy.param.repo: Repository root to inspect (defaults to the configured repo or the current working directory).
